project.title: CDC's Traveler-Based Genomic Surveillance Program
project.description: Genomic surveillance and sequencing of SARS-CoV-2 variants and other pathogens from U.S. arriving international air travelers (pooled and individual) from several major U.S. airports. Sequencing conducted by Concentric by Ginkgo Bioworks as part of CDC's Traveler-based Genomic Surveillance program.
